title: Kto je kto?
topic: Martin goes to Sunday lunch with his girlfriend Lenka's family, takes her brother for her father and makes friends with her little nephew

sentences.sk: Je nedeľa. Martin a Lenka idú na obed k jej rodičom.
sentences.en: It is Sunday. Martin and Lenka are going to her parents' for lunch.

sentences.sk: Lenka, kto tam bude?
sentences.en: Lenka, who will be there?

sentences.sk: Lenka mu ukazuje fotku.
sentences.en: Lenka shows him a photo.

sentences.sk: Pozri. Toto je môj otec a toto je moja mama.
sentences.en: Look. This is my father and this is my mother.

sentences.sk: Tento muž je môj brat Michal a toto je jeho manželka.
sentences.en: This man is my brother Michal and this is his wife.

sentences.sk: A toto malé dieťa je ich syn Miško.
sentences.en: And this small child is their son Miško.

sentences.sk: Tvoj otec a tvoj brat sú veľmi podobní.
sentences.en: Your father and your brother look very alike.

sentences.sk: Lenka zazvoní pri dverách a dvere otvorí muž.
sentences.en: Lenka rings at the door, and a man opens it.

sentences.sk: Dobrý deň, pán Novák! Teší ma.
sentences.en: Good afternoon, Mr Novák! Nice to meet you.

sentences.sk: Ja nie som otec. Ja som Michal, Lenkin brat!
sentences.en: I'm not her father. I'm Michal, Lenka's brother!

sentences.sk: Všetci sa smejú.
sentences.en: Everyone laughs.

sentences.sk: V kuchyni varí Lenkina mama a otec sedí pri stole.
sentences.en: In the kitchen Lenka's mother is cooking and her father is sitting at the table.

sentences.sk: Vitajte u nás, Martin! Máte brata alebo sestru?
sentences.en: Welcome to our home, Martin! Do you have a brother or a sister?

sentences.sk: Mám jednu sestru. Brata nemám.
sentences.en: I have one sister. I don't have a brother.

sentences.sk: A kde býva vaša rodina?
sentences.en: And where does your family live?

sentences.sk: Moji rodičia a moja sestra bývajú v Košiciach.
sentences.en: My parents and my sister live in Košice.

sentences.sk: Po obede berie malý Miško Martina do svojej izby.
sentences.en: After lunch little Miško takes Martin to his room.

sentences.sk: Toto je moja izba. Tu spím.
sentences.en: This is my room. I sleep here.

sentences.sk: Martin, ty máš rád Lenku?
sentences.en: Martin, do you like Lenka?

sentences.sk: Áno, mám ju veľmi rád.
sentences.en: Yes, I like her very much.

sentences.sk: Ja tiež. Lenka je moja teta!
sentences.en: Me too. Lenka is my aunt!

sentences.sk: Tak teraz si aj ty môj kamarát.
sentences.en: Then now you're my friend too.

sentences.sk: Miško sa smeje a ukazuje Martinovi všetky svoje autíčka.
sentences.en: Miško laughs and shows Martin all his toy cars.

recap: Before Sunday lunch Lenka shows Martin a photo of her family. At the door he greets her brother Michal as her father, which makes everyone laugh, and after lunch he makes friends with Michal's little son Miško.

teší.gloss: pleases (teší ma: nice to meet you)

vaša.gloss: your (to two or more people, or politely)
